python scripts/eval_aggregate.py --input /tmp/all_results.json --max-unsupported-pct '{{workflow.parameters.max-unsupported-pct}}' --min-claims '{{workflow.parameters.min-claims}}'
rc=$?
echo "===EVAL_FINDINGS_TGZ_BEGIN pod={{pod.name}}==="
tar czf - -C /app eval_findings | base64 -w0
echo
echo "===EVAL_FINDINGS_TGZ_END==="
exit $rc

python grounding_check.py --tickers '{{inputs.parameters.ticker}}' --arms '{{workflow.parameters.arms}}' --json-out /tmp/result.json
rc=$?
echo "===EVAL_FINDINGS_TGZ_BEGIN pod={{pod.name}}==="
tar czf - -C /app eval_findings | base64 -w0
echo
echo "===EVAL_FINDINGS_TGZ_END==="
exit $rc

python grounding_check.py --tickers '{{inputs.parameters.ticker}}' --arms '{{workflow.parameters.arms}}' --json-out /tmp/result.json
rc=$?
echo "===EVAL_FINDINGS_TGZ_BEGIN pod={{pod.name}}==="
tar czf - -C /app eval_findings | base64 -w0
echo
echo "===EVAL_FINDINGS_TGZ_END==="
exit $rc

python scripts/eval_aggregate.py --input /tmp/all_results.json --max-unsupported-pct '{{workflow.parameters.max-unsupported-pct}}' --min-claims '{{workflow.parameters.min-claims}}'
rc=$?
echo "===EVAL_FINDINGS_TGZ_BEGIN pod={{pod.name}}==="
tar czf - -C /app eval_findings | base64 -w0
echo
echo "===EVAL_FINDINGS_TGZ_END==="
exit $rc
